paragraphs.text: Pendrell Vale was a valley located in Tolaria on Dominaria . It is known for its mists and the mysterious Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale in its midst.

The vale emanated strange magics that inhibited the use of summoning magic, allowing any mage who taps into its power the ability to force their foes to expend great quantities of mana to keep summoned creatures from disappearing into nothingness. These strange properties may have been a result of Urza 's failed time travel experiments.
After the destruction of Tolaria, Pendrell Vale's magic continued to emanate, calling out to certain wizards who took to worship the ancient Tabernacle.
In the Legends Cycle I is told of Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale in Jamuraan Scarwood . This apparent discrepancy has not been explained.
